key_highlights: RBA Governor Bullock signals further rate hikes to cool job market, lifting bond yields and pressuring ASX valuations
ASX treads water as rate fears offset a tech-led rally following Wall Street's AI-driven session
Global diesel shortage from Iran/Ukraine wars to persist into 2027; Saudi pipeline restart offers partial relief but Australian fuel prices surge
Iron ore downside risk persists amid China rebalancing toward robotics and away from heavy infrastructure
Australian gold miners (Platina, Dalaroo, Broken Hill, Larvotto) active with new discoveries and capital raises
Sydney housing market under severe stress; federal/state governments face debt cliff
Jetstar industrial action escalates with staff waiving baggage/seat fees, pressuring Qantas Group margins
El Nino 'Godzilla' event approaching, threatening agricultural output and insurance claims

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces structural downside as China pivots to robotics; gold miners see renewed activity with multiple ASX-listed explorers reporting discoveries
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from weak iron ore; gold names (PLA.AX, DAR.AX, BHP gold segment) attract rotation flows

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish pivot supports NIMs but raises credit-risk concerns amid housing stress; government debt cliff pressures sovereign spreads
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates short-term but face housing-driven NPL risk; watch ^AX5J

sectors.trend: Diesel shortage from Iran/Ukraine wars drives Australian fuel prices higher; Saudi pipeline restart provides partial supply relief; energy prices volatile
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from elevated oil/diesel; downstream refiners face margin pressure

sectors.trend: ASX tech leads index higher on AI trade spillover from US; data centre build-out strains net-zero targets
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WES.AX, XRO.AX, SOL.AX) benefit from global AI capex cycle; watch power/infrastructure constraints

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates; Adelaide CBD foot traffic declines; fuel costs squeeze consumer spending
sectors.implications: QAN.AX (Jetstar parent) faces margin compression; WES.AX, WOW.AX under pressure from input costs

sectors.trend: Global obesity drug data (Viking Therapeutics) positive for sector; CSL remains defensive anchor
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (health) benefit from defensive rotation; obesity pipeline a long-term tailwind

key_themes: RBA rate hike cycle resuming – 'Bullock hawk' narrative dominates
Geopolitical oil/diesel crisis (Iran, Ukraine) creating energy inflation
China structural rebalancing away from iron ore toward robotics
Australian housing market correction, particularly Sydney
Government fiscal deterioration and debt cliff
El Nino climate risk to agriculture and insurance
AI/tech capex cycle supporting global and ASX tech equities

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour floating-rate and short-duration credit; hedge with ^AXJO short positions
Overweight energy producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); hedge transport/consumer exposure; monitor Saudi pipeline output
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and critical minerals
Underweight REITs and home-loan-heavy banks; monitor NAB.AX, ANZ.AX credit metrics
Review SFR.AX, WBC.AX insurance book exposure; favour drought-resistant ag names
Monitor 10Y GSB yields; reduce sovereign bond exposure; favour inflation-linked assets

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian gold miners and critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical risk premium, iron ore weakness, and multiple ASX-listed discoveries (Platina, Dalaroo, Broken Hill, Larvotto) support sector rotation

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy producers ahead of sustained diesel shortage
opportunities.rationale: Global diesel deficit to 2027 from Iran/Ukraine wars; Saudi pipeline restart insufficient; Australian fuel prices surging

opportunities.recommendation: Selective ASX tech exposure on AI capex cycle
opportunities.rationale: Global AI trade powering markets; ASX tech leading index; data centre build-out supports infrastructure names

defensive_moves.rationale: China rebalancing to robotics; iron ore downside risk structural; China cracks widening

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration or floating-rate instruments
defensive_moves.rationale: Bullock hawkish; RBA to hike further; bond yields rising; ASX valuations under pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Sydney REITs and consumer discretionary
defensive_moves.rationale: Sydney housing bloodbath; fuel costs squeezing consumer; Adelaide CBD foot traffic declining

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound ('treads water') as RBA hawkish signalling offsets tech/AI rally. Rate fears cap upside; diesel shock adds inflationary pressure. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and oil prices.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from China iron ore demand, housing correction, and fiscal deterioration weigh on 6–12 month outlook. Gold, energy, and critical minerals offer relative outperformance. AI/tech provides cyclical support. El Nino adds agricultural risk.

Iran/Ukraine oil supply developments and Saudi pipeline output
China GDP and property sector data
El Nino onset and agricultural impact
ASX gold miner assay results (Dalaroo, Platina)
watch_list: Brent crude and diesel crack spreads
RBA cash rate and Bullock speeches
QAN.AX (Jetstar) share price and industrial action
China PMI and property sales data
